To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

robots are needed for health care, but the design of robots for health care is a complex task that needs to take into account the needs of patients, caregivers, health-care professionals, and the health-care system.

the most important capabilities of medical and health care robots are: (1) the ability to work with patients, (2) to perform complex medical procedures, and (3) to provide a high level of safety and security.

medical and health-care robotic systems should be able to perform complex tasks that require high levels of dexterity, precision, and intelligence; that the robots should be able to interact with people and with other robots in a natural manner; that the robots must have a good degree of autonomy, and that they should be able to operate in unstructured, unpredictable, and dynamically changing environments.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how to design, develop, and use robotic technology for the benefit of human health and well being.
the development of robots that will improve human health and quality of life by providing assistance to medical and health-care professionals, and by providing direct assistance to patients.
the design of robotic systems to improve human health.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

medical and health-care robotic systems are expected to be an integral part of the health-care industry and society in the future, and they will be used in all aspects of the health-care delivery chain, from prevention to rehabilitation, and from diagnosis to treatment.
medical and health-care robotic systems are needed to assist humans to live longer, healthier, and more independent lives.
the field of robotics has a significant role to play in the improvement of health-care and medical systems.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
medical and health-care robotic systems should be able to perform a wide variety of tasks, including surgery, rehabilitation, and health-care monitoring.
we have identified the most important capabilities that medical and health-care robotic systems should possess.
medical and health-care robotic systems should be safe, reliable, and effective, and that they should be designed with the patient in mind, with a focus on human-centered and user-centered design.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the design and implementation of medical and health- care robotics is a challenging task, which requires the development and integration of several different research areas, from the medical field to computer vision, artificial intelligence, and control.
medical and health-care robotic systems are not only capable to improve human health but also to improve human well-being and the quality of human life.
the medical and health-care robot systems should be designed with the goal of increasing the quality of life of the patients and caregivers.
